prompt: hi! we're team 99902, rookie team on the gobilda strafer kit with mecanum wheels, just a control hub. can you write us a teleop opmode so we can drive?

assertions.name: no-code-before-confirmation
assertions.text: No OpMode/.java file is generated before the config is explicitly confirmed — the run ends with questions and/or a confirm-back statement, not generated code

assertions.name: specific-confirm-back-claim
assertions.text: The output contains an explicit restatement of the config values followed by a request for confirmation (the specific confirm-before-generate behavior, not merely the presence of any question)

assertions.name: empirical-question-order
assertions.text: Among the questions asked, opmode style appears first or among the first, matching question_order.py's real branching-factor ranking (opmode_style=15 is the top-ranked feature), not an arbitrary order

assertions.name: hub-generation-not-asked
assertions.text: hub_generation is NOT asked as a question (clean-case control: REV Control Hub is the sole legal system in 2025-26, so the question has zero information gain)
